system.model: none — deterministic, offline pipeline. The human-judgment layer is a curated, fully-auditable decision table that stands in for an LLM call so the whole system is reproducible with no API key and no nondeterminism. The seams (Router -> Retrieval -> Action -> Gate) are exactly where an LLM would drop in.
system.preference_demo: m015: always CC Priya on Hartwell & Cho legal mail (applied to m018/m048/m055); m041: no meetings before 11:00am (applied to m043)

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every one of the 100 messages exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a one-line reason, leaving none undecided.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all 100 messages, each with category+disposition+reason, then 'undecided: 0'. Writes decisions.json.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R1 (one Router event per message id); decisions.json

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in a specific earlier message, records the message ids it drew on, and does not replay credentials found in email.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft for m008 that cites m003, refuses to resend connection credentials by email, and directs the recipient to the shared secrets manager.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R2 (a draft event whose cited ids appear as real messages)

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends/deletes/forwards without per-action approval or an explicit --dry-run that shows what it would do.
capabilities.observable: Prints every send it WOULD perform, then 'outbox/ writes: 0'. Without --dry-run it prompts y/n before each send; --auto-deny records every action as denied.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R3 (ApprovalGate events); pending_actions.json; approval_log.jsonl

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference and applies it on a later run after the process has fully exited.
capabilities.observable: First run stores 'CC Priya on Hartwell & Cho legal mail' (from m015) to memory/preferences.json and exits. Second, fresh process applies it to m018/m048/m055 without being told again.
capabilities.evidence: memory/preferences.json on disk between runs; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4; memory_demo.md

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions/social-engineering addressed to the assistant inside message bodies, refuses them, flags them, and reports them — without deleting, forwarding, or hiding them.
capabilities.observable: Prints 'FLAGGED: m024 attempted [prompt_injection:...] -- not done, left in place, not forwarded' for all 7 hostile messages. outbox/ contains no message to any address named inside a flagged message; none are deleted.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R5 (a refusal event per hostile id); security_design.md

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane view (Pending Actions, Flagged Items, Commitments Calendar), commitments cited to source message ids, cross-thread commitments supported, conflicts surfaced.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html/json. Commitments pane cites source ids; flags two conflicts: '15 3:00pm -> [m010, m061]' and 'wednesday 2:00pm -> [m013, m016]'; and the cross-thread board-deck-by-16th commitment citing [m038, m040].
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html and dashboard.json; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Smart Daily Digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a one-screen digest: what needs Sam today, what can wait, and what was auto-archived (aggregated by category, not individually).
capabilities.observable: Prints three sections. 'Needs you today' contains the investor intro m010, the legal signature m018, and press m046; 'Auto-archived' lists categories by count (notification/receipt/newsletter/human_conversation).

capabilities.name: Long Thread Resolution
capabilities.claim: Collapses each long multi-participant thread into participants + milestones + open items, grounded with per-line message-id citations.
capabilities.observable: For t-launch (9 messages, 4 participants) and t-api (4 messages) it prints every milestone by id and the open items (e.g. t-launch open item = m030 pricing approval).

capabilities.name: Relationship Intelligence
capabilities.claim: Builds a per-correspondent profile (relationship type, message volume, who is waiting longest on Sam) from sender patterns already used by the pipeline.
capabilities.observable: Prints a ranked table: investor aria.f@northwind.vc waiting on [m010, m043]; legal m.cho@hartwellcho.com on [m018, m055]; colleague priya@paperjet.io on [m030, m040]; etc.

capabilities.name: Autonomous Assistant Planning
capabilities.claim: Produces a prioritized day plan from decisions + commitment dates. Purely informational: every recommended send still has to pass R3's gate.
capabilities.observable: Prints an ordered plan (escalations first, then replies, each by commitment date), marking every escalation '[needs approval]'.

capabilities.name: Preference-Aware Negotiation Agent
capabilities.claim: Drafts a preference-aware counter-proposal for a scheduling violation and surfaces conflicts without inventing availability. Never sends — drafts still pass R3.
capabilities.observable: Drafts a counter for m043 (Monday 9:00am violates the stored 11:00am cutoff from m041) and conflict notices for [m010,m061] and [m013,m016] that state no alternative availability is grounded in the inbox.
